svg.title: Flash-steam geothermal plant — Jarðhitavirkjun með gufuskilju
svg.desc: A production well feeds a vertical separator whose upper steam pipe leads to a turbine and lower liquid pipe returns underground.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"power-geothermal-flash","label_en":"Flash-steam geothermal plant","label_is":"Jarðhitavirkjun með gufuskilju","section":"06","category_en":"Power plants and generation","category_is":"Orkuver og orkuframleiðsla","batch":3,"tags":["power","geothermal"],"description":"A production well feeds a vertical separator whose upper steam pipe leads to a turbine and lower liquid pipe returns underground.","design_note":"The intermediate separator with a water level visibly distinguishes flash steam from direct dry-steam generation.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
